messages.subject: Multithreading INLA w/ multithreaded ATLAS?
parts: The multithreading in INLA is really impressive - it just works. I'm tempted to build from source to see if I can get some additional speedups for my mammoth model, but I'm not sure if I should build against multithreaded ATLAS libraries or not. INLA seems to be using the available resources about as efficiently as possible (staying solidly in the 900-1150% CPU usage range when I give it 12 cores), so I'm wondering if it's best not to upset the balance...

on my laptop I get a 20-25% speedup compiling it for that particular
cpu and using ATLAS. Also using google-perftools helps. I didn't had
much success using multithreaded ATLAS libraries.

If you want to compile it yourself, its a good idea to start from here
